ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.60:0.40 low-intensity (black) to high-intensity (white) pixel distribution across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity pigmentation in the medial and central fluke regions; high-intensity contiguous patches localized on the distal lobes (tips), featuring transition zones with high-frequency mottled pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Obtuse V-shaped central depression with a calculated angle of approximately 140 degrees and shallow vertical depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular trailing edge with low-amplitude, non-uniform serrations; several distinct pixel-peak clusters on the left lobe trailing boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-modal curve featuring concavity adjacent to the median notch transitioning to a convex sweep towards the distal extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distributed clusters of circular dark-pixel focal points (0.5-2.0% of lobe width) localized within the high-intensity white patches on both distal lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct multi-directional, unaligned high-intensity linear tracks (rake marks) visible against the low-intensity medial and right-medial pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive linear rake marks across the right lobe and central region; concentrated circular scarring at the distal tips.
